s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) Last time, we met our teacher and the chalkboard. (pause) Today, we meet new friends at school!
words: To make a friend, we need some special words. (pause) Here are four friendship words. (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap each picture and say it with me!
words-1: Friend. (pause) A friend is someone kind we play with.
words-2: Smile. (pause) A smile is a happy face. (pause) Show me your smile!
words-3: Greet. (pause) When we greet, we say, Good morning!
words-4: Wave. (pause) We wave our hand to say hello.
act: You know the words! Now let us practice being a friend. (pause) Stand up! (pause) I say it. (pause) You do it. (pause) Then tap the button.
act-1: Smile! (pause) Show me a big happy face!
act-4: Point to yourself. (pause) Say, My name is, and your name!
find: Great acting! Now use your ears. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) I say a word. (pause) You tap the picture.
find-q2: Where are the friends? Tap them!
s1: You can greet and smile. Now let us see it in a story! (pause) Story time! (pause) Our story is, Tala's New Friend. (pause) It is Monday at school. (pause) A new boy comes in. (pause) His name is Lino.
s2: What does Lino do? (pause) Lino sits alone at his desk. (pause) He looks down. (pause) He does not know anyone yet.
feel: Oh no. Let us think about Lino. (pause) Look at Lino. (pause) He is new. (pause) He sits alone.
feel-q1-yes: Yes! Lino feels shy and a little sad. (pause) Who can help him?
s3: Then, Tala has an idea. (pause) Tala sees Lino. (pause) She smiles and waves. (pause) Good morning! My name is Tala. (pause) What is your name?
s4: What does Lino say? (pause) Lino smiles. (pause) Good morning, Tala! My name is Lino. (pause) Tala says, do you want to draw with us? (pause) Yes! (pause) Now they are friends!
check: Tala made a new friend! (pause) Let us think about the story.
check-q1: Who is the new boy in class?
check-q1-yes: Yes! Lino is the new boy.
check-q2: What did Tala say to Lino?
check-q2-yes: Yes! Tala said, Good morning! My name is Tala.
order: Can you remember the whole story? (pause) Tap the pictures in order. (pause) First. (pause) Next. (pause) Last.
order-2: Next, Tala smiled and greeted Lino.
order-3: Last, they drew together. They are friends!
order-yes: First, next, last! (pause) You told the whole story!
greet-words: Tala greeted Lino. How do YOU greet a friend? (pause) How do you greet a friend? (pause) Tap one. (pause) Then say it with me.
talk: Now make a new friend, just like Tala! (pause) Turn to a friend or a family member. (pause) Smile and wave. (pause) Say: Good morning! My name is Tala. (pause) Use your own name!
talk-example: Good morning! My name is Lino.
verse: Tala was kind to Lino. The Bible tells us about friends. (pause) Our Bible verse this week is, (pause) A friend loves at all times. (pause) That means, a good friend is kind every day. (pause) Like Tala!
verse-verse: A friend loves at all times. (pause) Proverbs seventeen, verse seventeen.
done: You were a great friend today! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You learned four friendship words. (pause) You told the story in order. (pause) And you greeted a friend! (pause) Tomorrow, we learn to share and help!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
